component.description: OSLON SSL 80 high-power white illumination LED (LUW CR7P, 'EQ white' / Brilliant Mix). Single phosphor-converted InGaN emitter in a 3.0 x 3.0 mm SMT ceramic package with a silicone lens giving a prefocused ~80 deg beam. Photometric part: luminous flux typ 156 lm and luminous efficacy typ 151 lm/W at IF = 350 mA. This document describes the ordered grade Q65111A3446 = type LUW CR7P-LSLU-MMMW-1: brightness selection LSLU (flux groups LS/LT/LU, 140...180 lm), chromaticity selection MMMW, forward-voltage groups L1/L2/M1/MX. Sibling order groups (see orderingVariants) share the same EQ-white color / CRI grade and differ only in brightness bin (LTMP) or chromaticity sub-selection (MCML).
component.package: OSLON SSL 80, SMT ceramic 3.0x3.0mm with silicone lens

pinout.name: A
pinout.description: Anode (+). Forward current flows in here. One of the two electrical solder pads.

pinout.name: C
pinout.description: Cathode (-). The package is marked on the cathode side. An integrated ESD-protection device is connected in parallel with the LED chip.

pinout.name: NC
pinout.description: Center 'no contact pad' per the package outline - a mechanical solder pad only, not electrically connected to the die and not a thermal pad (heat is extracted through the anode/cathode pads).

measurements.conditionsVerbatim: Luminous Flux phi_V typ. 156 lm (headline, page 1) at IF = 350 mA, TS = 25 degC. Binned flux groups (page 5): LS 140...150, LT 150...164, LU 164...180, MP 180...194 lm. The ordered brightness selection LSLU (order code Q65111A3446, groups LS/LT/LU) spans 140...180 lm; only one brightness group ships per packing unit. Brightness measured during a ~10 ms current pulse, tolerance +/-7%. (sourcePage 1 = the typ headline; the group min/max span is on page 5.)
Luminous efficacy typ. 151 lm/W at IF = 350 mA, TS = 25 degC (headline feature, page 1).

Luminous Intensity IV at IF = 350 mA, TS = 25 degC (page 5 Brightness Groups). Per-group typ IV: LS 81, LT 88, LU 96, MP 105 cd. The ordered LSLU selection spans groups LS/LT/LU, so IV ranges 81 (LS) to 96 (LU) cd - stored as that envelope, mirroring the luminous_flux ranging. Measured during a ~10 ms current pulse, tolerance +/-7%.

Forward voltage VF min. 2.80 / typ. 2.95 / max. 3.25 V at IF = 350 mA, TS = 25 degC (page 4). Binned VF groups (page 5): L1 2.80...2.90, L2 2.90...3.00, M1 3.00...3.10, MX 3.10...3.25 V; one VF group ships per packing unit. VF measured during a ~1 ms current pulse, tolerance +/-0.05 V.

Reverse voltage VR max. 1.2 V at a reverse test current IR = 20 mA (page 4). This is a diode-test figure, not an operating rating - an LED is not designed for reverse operation; a separate allowable reverse current of 200 mA is listed as a maximum rating (page 3).
Color rendering index Ra typ. 65 at IF = 350 mA, TS = 25 degC (page 4). Dimensionless 0-100 index. Measured during a ~10 ms current pulse, tolerance +/-2.

Chromaticity coordinate Cx typ. 0.37 acc. to CIE 1931 (EQ white / Brilliant Mix), at IF = 350 mA, TS = 25 degC (pages 1, 4). The fine chromaticity sub-bins of the ordered MMMW selection (groups MM..MW, page 7) sit around this nominal; chromaticity groups measured during a ~10 ms pulse, tolerance +/-0.005.

Chromaticity coordinate Cy typ. 0.44 acc. to CIE 1931 (EQ white / Brilliant Mix), at IF = 350 mA, TS = 25 degC (pages 1, 4). Pairs with Cx = 0.37 to fix the color point above the blackbody locus. Chromaticity groups measured during a ~10 ms pulse, tolerance +/-0.005.

This is an 'EQ white' (Brilliant Mix) part; no single nominal CCT is printed on the datasheet. The nominal color point is Cx = 0.37, Cy = 0.44 (CIE 1931), which lies above the blackbody locus. The chromaticity-coordinate-group diagram (page 6) spans the CCT iso-lines from ~2700 K to 5000 K across the EQ-white bin region; encoded as that range rather than inventing a single value. The ordered MMMW chromaticity selection is a sub-region of this.

parameters.name: Viewing angle (full angle at half intensity)

measurements.conditionsVerbatim: Viewing angle at 50% IV, 2phi typ. 80 deg (pages 1, 4). Printed already as the FULL cone angle (2phi = 80 deg), not a half-angle, so no doubling applied. Prefocused OSLON SSL 80 radiation pattern.

parameters.name: Thermal resistance, junction to solder point
aliases: thermal resistance junction to solder point

measurements.conditionsVerbatim: Real thermal resistance junction / solder point Rth JS real typ. 9.6 / max. 10.8 K/W (page 4; K/W is numerically identical to degC/W for a temperature delta). This is the 'real' (measured) value. Osram also prints an 'electrical' (efficiency-corrected, eta_e = 38%) Rth JS el typ. 6.0 / max. 6.7 K/W. Rth max is based on 6-sigma statistics.

Forward current IF max. 1000 mA (1.0 A) at TS = 25 degC (page 3 Maximum Ratings). The datasheet states the operating range as 100...1000 mA with 'Do not use below 100 mA' (page 12) and a derating of the max permissible current above a solder-point temperature knee.
Surge current IFM max. 2000 mA (2.0 A) (page 3 Maximum Ratings). Non-repetitive single-event surge, distinct from the 1.0 A DC rating.
Reverse current IR max. 200 mA (0.2 A) (page 3 Maximum Ratings). This is an 'allowable reverse current' rating (note 2), not a leakage measurement; an LED is not designed for reverse operation.

Junction temperature Tj max. 135 degC (page 3 Maximum Ratings). An absolute junction temperature Tj,abs = 160 degC is also listed, verified by testing 30 pieces (no catastrophic failures; luminous flux better than L70B50 after 1000 h).
ESD withstand voltage VESD 8 kV (8000 V), acc. to ANSI/ESDA/JEDEC JS-001 HBM, Class 3B (page 3). The LED integrates an ESD-protection device in parallel with the chip.
Operating temperature range Top = -40 ... 120 degC (page 3 Maximum Ratings).
Storage temperature range Tstg = -40 ... 120 degC (page 3 Maximum Ratings).
